# `mise edit`

- **Usage**: `mise edit [FLAGS] [PATH]`
- **Effect**: modifies state
- **Source code**: [`src/cli/edit.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/edit.rs)

Edit mise.toml interactively

## Arguments

### `[PATH]`

Path to the config file to create

## Flags

### `-g --global`

Edit the global config file (~/.config/mise/config.toml)

### `-n --dry-run`

Show what would be generated without writing to file

### `-t --tool-versions <TOOL_VERSIONS>`

Path to a .tool-versions file to import tools from

[1m[4mExamples:[22m[24m

```
[1mmise edit[22m             [2m# edit mise.toml interactively[22m
[1mmise edit .mise.toml[22m  [2m# edit a specific file[22m
[1mmise edit -g[22m          [2m# edit the global config file[22m
[1mmise edit -y[22m          [2m# skip interactive editor[22m
[1mmise edit -n[22m          [2m# preview without writing[22m
```
